implements: the six entries of the frozen config's 'metrics' list; its sha256 is taken from o2-plan.json
written: 2026-10-19, after all 30 items were terminal. The author had seen each item's protocol status and IRC-local barrier, but had not computed any delta_Ea_DFT, anchor-relative barrier, catalogue difference or sign agreement.
certification_counts: Denominator = all planned items of that kind (10). Every item was attempted exactly once; an item that ended in a chain exception has no verdict and counts as attempted, not passed. Wilson 95% interval.
paired_parents: Parents whose candidate and reference both pass. Every other parent is listed with the reason it is excluded.
barrier_vs_anchor_kcal: (E_TS - E_min(anchor)) * hartree_to_kcal, for both candidate and reference; the anchor must be MINIMUM_PASS
local_barrier_kcal: qc_protocol's own TS minus IRC reactant-end energy; reported alongside, not used for any count

catalogue_check.context: report whether reference_id equals the parent's anchor_reference_id: the T1x catalogue barrier is measured from that reaction's own reactant geometry, which may differ from the anchor

sign_agreement: Over paired parents: sign(delta_Ea_DFT) == sign(delta_Ea_xTB from the frozen plan); an exact zero counts as disagreement. Wilson 95% interval.
delta_ea_dft_summary: xtbflow.v1.metrics.cluster_summary over paired parents, groups = parent split_group (handoff section 3, rule 4); null with a reason when fewer than two parents or groups
timings: Per item: chain wall (verdict or unexpected_failure wall_s), Slurm RunTime of the attempt that produced the work directory, QC-kernel wall per stage (sum of scf/gradient/hessian rows), geomeTRIC wall per stage, and counts of scf, gradient and hessian calls from stage_timings
gpu_ledger: Every Slurm job in o2-jobs/ledger.json, ledger_v2.json and ledger_v4.json, with dispatcher version, state and RunTime seconds; totals by category and against the 16 GPU-hour budget. The 2026-10-17 diagnostic GPU checks (Slurm 3371 and two short srun checks) are outside this ledger and are disclosed in the report.
plot: delta_ea_scatter.svg: delta_Ea_xTB (x) against delta_Ea_DFT (y) for paired parents, with y=x and zero lines; descriptive only
determinism: results.json is written with sorted keys and must be byte-identical when re-run from the same inputs and source commit
